entries.title: Blair Witch

emulation.notes: Use the native PC flat-screen build for the main archive route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with scalable settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Deluxe Edition is the best flat-screen route because it combines the complete 2019 game with the official soundtrack and digital artbook extras, while the PC build gives the strongest fidelity and capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Blair Witch Deluxe Edition on Steam and play the Windows PC build. For the VR-specific adaptation, play Blair Witch: VR Edition separately.

secondary.platform: Windows PC VR / PlayStation VR / Oculus Quest
secondary.exclusive_content: VR-specific presentation with redesigned interactive environments, new Bullet interactions, new sounds/events, and additional creature encounters.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample Blair Witch: VR Edition after the flat-screen PC playthrough if the archive needs the VR-only mechanics and presentation.
secondary.why: Official Bloober materials describe the VR Edition as rebuilt for VR with redesigned interactivity and additional creature encounters.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with scalable settings and Deluxe Edition extras.
all_releases.reason: primary: best flat-screen fidelity/capture route and complete Deluxe package.
skip: same flat-screen game, but no sourced content or capture advantage over Windows PC.
skip: same flat-screen game, but no sourced content or capture advantage over Windows PC.
skip: portable route, but no sourced content advantage over Windows PC.

all_releases.platform: Oculus Quest / Oculus Quest 2 (Oculus Quest Edition)
all_releases.fidelity: Standalone VR adaptation built for Quest hardware.
all_releases.reason: secondary: VR-specific version with unique interaction changes, but lower standalone-VR fidelity than PC VR.
skip: streaming route with no content advantage over native Windows PC.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC VR / PlayStation VR / Oculus Rift (VR Edition)
all_releases.fidelity: VR Edition rebuilt for PC head-mounted displays and PSVR, with extra interaction and encounter features.
all_releases.reason: secondary: separate VR adaptation with unique VR mechanics; play only if the VR-specific presentation matters after the primary flat-screen route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The flat-screen PC Deluxe Edition is the best main playthrough, but the VR Edition has unique VR mechanics and interactions that are not part of the flat-screen release.

entries.remaster_caveats: The VR versions are separate adaptations rather than a replacement for the 2019 flat-screen game.

entries.title: Blair Witch: VR Edition

emulation.notes: Use a supported PC VR headset with the SteamVR release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC VR presentation with headset-dependent resolution, refresh rate, and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC VR release is the best VR route because it carries the VR-specific rebuild with PC-VR capture flexibility and avoids the standalone Quest hardware ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Blair Witch VR on Steam and play with a supported PC VR headset. Use Quest or PSVR only for hardware preference.
